title: Baroque
synopsis: Sting’s dungeon-crawling remake on PlayStation 2 — retained as the North American Atlus retail disc.

catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation 2 retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Complete in box. Light shelf wear consistent with age. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
Baroque reached North America as an Atlus localization of Sting’s PlayStation 2 remake — a tower descent through a ruined world that already had a late-1990s pedigree before this generation’s rebuild. The Japanese remake arrived in June 2007; Atlus published the NTSC-U edition (SLUS-21714) on April 8, 2008.

The shelf keeps the Atlus keep-case because that is how the work entered this region’s retail channel. Earlier Saturn and PlayStation versions are neighboring history; they are not invented here as stand-ins for the pressed PS2 copy in custody.

This filing widens the PlayStation 2 RPG holdings beyond Persona without forcing Baroque into another series map it does not need.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 while expanding the PlayStation 2 physical shelf.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation 2 edition published by Atlus (SLUS-21714). It remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: PlayStation 2 remake first issued in Japan on June 28, 2007 (SLPM-66747). The North American Atlus localization followed on April 8, 2008 (SLUS-21714). A contemporary Wii edition and later reissues are neighboring objects and are not this filing.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this North American reference copy.
